HomePage.methodIntro: The method is simple but consistent: write the need down, make choices explicit, deliver in batches and support what comes next.

methodSteps.title: Scoping
methodSteps.text: Understand the need, constraints and expected outcome. Scope and success criteria are written down.

methodSteps.title: Design
methodSteps.text: Choose the architecture, tools and breakdown. Risks and trade-offs are made explicit.

methodSteps.title: Delivery
methodSteps.text: Build in shippable batches, with regular checkpoints and tests on critical journeys.

methodSteps.title: Support
methodSteps.text: Ship to production, document, hand over and adjust. The project stays maintainable after delivery.

AboutPage.title: Talum, a pragmatic and reliable approach.
AboutPage.description: Background, values and working method of Armel BOUGMA, founder of Talum, in Lille and Abidjan.
AboutPage.intro: I design useful, maintainable digital solutions that fit my clients’ environment.
AboutPage.founderRole: Lead developer and project manager · Lille & Abidjan
AboutPage.story: In Lille and Abidjan, I support small businesses, startups, schools and non-profits that need a serious contact able to scope, build and support a digital project without unnecessary jargon.
AboutPage.storySecond: Work always starts from the real need: understand the business, write the scope, choose a proportionate architecture and deliver something useful. Everything else — technology, tools, method — serves that outcome.
zones: Support on key phases: scoping, development, cloud, AI and follow-up
AboutPage.methodTitle: The same method, whatever the project.
AboutPage.methodIntro: It reduces misunderstandings and makes decisions visible; it does not add process for its own sake.

methodSteps.title: Scoping
methodSteps.text: Understand the need and constraints. Write the scope, objectives and success criteria.

methodSteps.title: Design
methodSteps.text: Choose the architecture and breakdown. Make risks, costs and trade-offs explicit.

methodSteps.title: Delivery
methodSteps.text: Ship in batches, with checkpoints and tests on critical journeys.

methodSteps.title: Support
methodSteps.text: Release to production, document, hand over and adjust over time.

LegalPage.title: Legal notice
LegalPage.intro: Administrative information, responsibilities and terms of use of the Talum website.
LegalPage.identityText: The Talum website is published by an independent structure. Official information — legal status, SIRET, registered address, VAT and publication director — must be completed before launch.
LegalPage.contactText: For any question or request, use the contact form available on the site. Final contact details must be validated before production release.
LegalPage.responsibilityText: Talum strives to provide reliable and up-to-date information but does not guarantee the absence of errors or omissions. Content is provided for information only and may change at any time.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy policy
PrivacyPage.intro: The site collects and processes information only as part of the business relationship and initial contact.
PrivacyPage.dataText: Information sent through the contact form includes name, email address, company or organisation, project type and message. This data is used only to answer the request.
PrivacyPage.usageText: Information is used to scope the need, prepare a response or proposal and organise a useful conversation. It is not sold or shared with third parties without professional necessity.
PrivacyPage.rightsText: Data subjects may request access, correction or deletion of their information. Retention periods, processors and GDPR contact details must be completed before production release.
